score_note: Provisional screening totals equal the nine criterion-point sums in the evidence notes. Candidates span POS-first retail products, ERP POS modules, hospitality POS and POS-adjacent infrastructure; scores are not a definitive ranking or approval to adopt.

records.name: Odoo Point of Sale (Community)
records.candidate_type: ERP suite with POS module; retail and hospitality-adjacent
records.retail_pos_fit: Strong potential where POS must integrate with Odoo inventory/accounting. Not POS-first; validate exact Community scope and workflow fit.
records.license: LGPLv3 for Community; Enterprise Edition separately licensed/proprietary.
records.license_notes: Exclude Enterprise code or proprietary Odoo Apps unless separately authorized; review module and dependency licenses.
records.hardware_integrations: Barcode, printer, touch-device and payment-terminal paths documented as project claims; exact models and regional availability untested.
records.offline_multistore: Temporary outage operation is documented/claimed; synchronization semantics unknown. Multi-store consolidation is a project claim, not verified.
records.arabic_rtl: Arabic POS coverage, RTL layout and receipts not verified.
records.maintenance: Active non-archived repository, pushed 2026-09-22; Community branch 19.0.
security_flags: Published disclosure channel; no independent audit or dependency assessment.
records.score_breakdown: 17/20 feature; 13/15 architecture; 15/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 10/10 license; 3/5 deployment; 4/5 APIs/hardware; 1/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: NexoPOS
records.candidate_type: POS-first Laravel/Vue retail web application; hospitality-adjacent add-on ecosystem
records.retail_pos_fit: Strong direct fit: checkout, orders, payments, refunds, registers, taxes, stock, procurement, customers and reports documented.
records.license: GPL-3.0 in LICENSE and GitHub metadata; composer.json says MIT, an unresolved contradiction.
records.license_notes: Resolve the license discrepancy before reuse or distribution. Gastro and MultiStore are separate add-ons; audit their licenses and availability.
records.hardware_integrations: Barcode/SKU and scale barcode/PLU evidenced; print-server/ESC-POS adapter is an add-on. Cash drawer/card-terminal certification not established.
records.offline_multistore: Offline sync unknown; MultiStore is a separate add-on, not core.
records.arabic_rtl: Arabic locale and RTL layout not verified.
security_flags: Past authorization/migration security fixes; no independent audit; review exact release and dependencies.
records.score_breakdown: 17/20 feature; 12/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 11/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 8/10 license; 3/5 deployment; 4/5 APIs/hardware; 2/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Apache OFBiz

pos_workflows: payment capture/authorization/refund; no full cashier workflow verified
